data_description.provider: Pick the utility whose customer portal you log in to: SEM for espaceclients.eauxdemarseille.fr (Ventabren, Bandol, Vitrolles, Trets and other peripheral communes), SEMM for espaceclients.eaudemarseille-metropole.fr (Marseille proper, La Ciotat, Cassis, Marignane and surroundings), or Vivaigo for espaceclients.vivaigo.fr (Salon, Berre, Lambesc, Eyguières and the Salon-Berre area).

statistics_import_failed.description: Eaux de Marseille could not import the historical monthly consumption for contract {contract_id}. The integration keeps polling normally and the issue will clear automatically on the next successful import. If the issue persists, check the Home Assistant logs for the underlying error and use the link below to open a bug report.
